epics.name: Foundational Infrastructure & Data Warehouse
epics.description: Synthetic analytics warehouse generator, seed scenarios, DuckDB & PostgreSQL connectors, and semantic layer models.

tasks.title: Build Realistic Synthetic Analytics Warehouse Generator
acceptance_criteria: Generates customers, products, orders, order_items, subscriptions, payments, refunds, marketing_channels, calendar_dim
Seeds reproducible scenarios: revenue decline (Q3/Q4), pricing change, churn spike, Simpson's paradox, refund surge
Creates DuckDB and PostgreSQL compatible database seed files and tables

tasks.title: Define Semantic Layer Specification & Models
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic schemas for Entity, Metric, Dimension, Relationship, and JoinGraph
Semantic catalog with canonical revenue, churn, AOV, refund rate metrics and allowable join paths
Semantic lookup, validation, and synonym resolution methods

tasks.title: Database Engine Connectors (DuckDB & PostgreSQL)
acceptance_criteria: Async/sync connection management for DuckDB and PostgreSQL
Read-only enforcement at connection and query execution level
Execution timeout and maximum row limit enforcement

epics.name: SQL Generator, Validator, Cost Estimator & Optimizer
epics.description: sqlglot AST parser, read-only verifier, join fanout detector, grain consistency, and EXPLAIN cost estimator.

tasks.title: SQL AST Validator & Read-Only Enforcer
acceptance_criteria: Parses SQL via sqlglot, prevents any mutating statements (DROP, DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT, ALTER)
Cross-references tables and columns against database catalog / semantic layer
Detects join fanout and validates GROUP BY grain matches metric definitions

tasks.title: Query Cost Estimator and Optimizer
acceptance_criteria: Generates EXPLAIN query plans for DuckDB / PostgreSQL
Estimates relative query cost, row count, and execution thresholds
Implements query caching and intermediate result hashing

epics.name: State Machine Orchestrator & Execution Loop
epics.description: Explicit finite state machine with machine-checkable guards, retry policies, and OBSERVE-PLAN-ACT-CRITIQUE cycle.

tasks.title: Explicit State Machine & Execution Policy
acceptance_criteria: Implements all 21 defined states from QUESTION_RECEIVED to COMPLETE
Transition guards preventing invalid state leaps
Configurable bounds: max steps, token budget, tool call limits, execution timeout
Durable state serialization and event logging for audit trail

epics.name: Hypothesis Engine & Statistical/Anomaly Tooling
epics.description: Competing hypothesis generation, ranking, Bayesian confidence updating, inferential stats, anomaly detection, and segmentation.

tasks.title: Autonomous Hypothesis Engine
acceptance_criteria: Generates multiple competing, falsifiable hypotheses for question
Ranks hypotheses by information gain and expected evidence
Updates probabilities on evidence arrival and records reasons for rejected hypotheses

tasks.title: Descriptive, Inferential & Effect-Size Statistical Engine
acceptance_criteria: Performs t-tests, Mann-Whitney U, Chi-square, and ANOVA with SciPy/statsmodels
Calculates 95% confidence intervals and Cohen's d / relative risk effect sizes
Checks statistical assumptions (normality, sample size, variance homogeneity)

tasks.title: Anomaly Detection & Multi-Dimensional Segmentation
acceptance_criteria: Time-series and distributional anomaly detection (IQR, Hampel, Isolation Forest)
Multi-dimensional shift-share contribution analysis across customer, product, geo, and channel
Identifies segments disproportionately responsible for top-line metrics change

epics.name: Causal Analysis, Critic Agent & Evidence Verification
epics.description: Causal vs associative separation, assumption checking, independent Critic Agent, calibrated confidence, and evidence citation guard.

tasks.title: Causal Inference Subsystem with Defensive Downgrade
acceptance_criteria: Implements Difference-in-Differences (DiD) and covariate adjustment
Validates unconfoundedness, common support, and parallel trends
Automatically labels non-causal observations as associative if assumptions fail

tasks.title: Independent Critic Agent
acceptance_criteria: Detects Simpson's paradox, survivorship bias, denominator traps, p-hacking, and post-hoc narrative
Applies multiple testing correction (Bonferroni & Benjamini-Hochberg)
Can reject analysis trajectory and force rework to earlier states

tasks.title: Evidence Store & Calibrated Confidence Scorer
acceptance_criteria: Creates immutable evidence objects with dataset hash, query, and metric definitions
Calculates multi-factor calibrated confidence score (0.0 to 1.0)
Deterministic citation verifier: validates that every numeric claim in report matches an evidence record

epics.name: Visualization, Report Generation & HITL Subsystem
epics.description: Plotly visualization generator, structured executive analyst report, and human-in-the-loop review workflow.

tasks.title: Plotly Visualization Engine & Structured Report Generator
acceptance_criteria: Generates intent-specific Plotly visualizations (waterfall, time-series, segment bars)
Drafts structured analyst report with executive summary, findings, hypothesis testing, caveats, and citations
Enforces strict evidence citations for all numbers

tasks.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Checkpoints & Review Manager
acceptance_criteria: Evaluates triggers: confidence < 0.70, high-risk causal claim, semantic ambiguity
Pauses state machine at HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and generates structured review packet
Resumes execution upon user decision (approve, reject, adjust)

epics.name: FastAPI Service, OpenTelemetry & Benchmark Evaluation Suite
epics.description: REST API with SSE streaming, OpenTelemetry tracing, end-to-end benchmark suite, and evaluation harness.

tasks.title: FastAPI Service with Event Streaming
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints for analysis submission, status inspection, SSE event stream, report, and HITL approval
Pydantic v2 schemas and structured error handling
Background asynchronous task management

tasks.title: Evaluation Harness & Benchmark Business Suite
acceptance_criteria: Suite of realistic business questions (e.g. Q3 revenue decline 8%, conversion paradox, churn jump)
Evaluation harness measuring SQL correctness, citation accuracy, anomaly precision, causal validity, and latency
Automated test runner producing JSON evaluation report

epics.name: React + TypeScript Frontend Analyst Workspace
epics.description: Production UI with real-time trajectory visualization, SQL inspector, hypothesis viewer, Plotly charts, and HITL approval.

tasks.title: React + TypeScript Analyst Workspace Frontend
acceptance_criteria: Interactive dashboard with Question input and state machine trajectory timeline
SQL query & cost viewer, hypothesis tree, segment decomposition, and anomaly charts
Plotly chart renderer and evidence citation popovers
HITL approval modal allowing user sign-off

epics.name: Packaging, Docker & AWS Production Deployment Guide
epics.description: Docker Compose setup, automated test suite verification, and production AWS deployment architecture.

tasks.title: Docker Setup, Test Matrix Verification & AWS Deployment Guide
acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for backend, DB, and frontend
Full test matrix passing with pytest
Comprehensive production deployment documentation
